title: Deep link routing for iPad
description: Update DeepLinkRouter in AggregatorApp/AggregatorApp.swift to detect the active navigation model. On iPad (hSizeClass == .regular or by reading @Environment iPadNavigationModel): aggregator://thread/{id} sets iPadNavigationModel.selectedSection = .threads and selectedThread to the thread with the given id; aggregator://article/{id} sets selectedSection and selectedArticle. On iPhone: existing selectedTab logic must remain completely unchanged. iPadNavigationModel must already be in the environment (from the NavigationModel bead).
acceptance_criteria: DeepLinkRouter dispatches to iPadNavigationModel on iPad
aggregator://thread/{id} navigates to correct thread on iPad
aggregator://article/{id} navigates to correct article on iPad
iPhone deep link behavior is unchanged
Malformed deep links do not crash the app
